changes: Start from actual pre-martingale 13.9.45 source tree; remove parameter editor, keypad hooks and diagnostic modules
Fixed broker stake; 1,2,4,8 direction clicks on successive losing sequences, with opt-in and user-selected maximum levels
Physical clicks do not wait for individual network acknowledgements; all identified child orders must settle before progressing once on aggregate PnL
Preserve 1 minute duration in settings, overlay, floating card and settings restore; retain phone controls, editable loss/time limits and passive received balance corrections
No amount or expiry field detection/editing, keyboard input, calculator or chart actions during activation; canvas mapping only CALL/PUT
Unknown/partial sequences stop without repeat; late settlements remain accounted for without advancing a new progression

browserModes: HTML direction buttons with no parameter fields

limitations: Broker stake and duration are set manually by the user; the bot never changes them.
Each click is a distinct broker order. Partial, rejected or unconfirmed sequences are not resent.
Existing signal freshness and stop controls can interrupt remaining clicks; already accepted orders stay tracked.
Native Windows and actual broker sessions have not been tested. Close Agent and broker windows to discard prior injected code before updating.
